hero.title: Who We Are
hero.description: Muslim Youth Association of Hungary (MIT) is a volunteer-driven organization dedicated to uniting and empowering Muslim youth across Hungary. We provide a space for learning, collaboration, and personal growth, where young Muslims can strengthen their faith and leadership skills. Rooted in the Islamic principles of faith, sincerity, excellence and unity, MIT strives to build a generation that serves both the Ummah and wider society with integrity and purpose.
hero.photoAlt: MIT receiving the FEMYSO Most Improved Organisation award

vision.title: MIT Vision
vision.description: A self-sustaining hub in Hungary where Muslim youth meet, grow, and become the confident leaders their community — the Ummah, and society need — to serve generations to come.

mission.title: MIT Mission
mission.description: To empower young Muslims in Hungary to grow in faith, lead with integrity, serve with compassion, and build bridges that strengthen both the Muslim community and Hungarian society.

values.title: Our Values
values.lede: Four commitments that shape how we gather, how we serve, and how we treat each other.

items.name: Sincerity
items.description: Serving with genuine intention and sincerity.

items.name: Excellence
items.description: Quality of service, professionalism, integrity, and authenticity — not perfection.

items.name: Unity
items.description: Welcoming everyone who is interested in learning, building connections within the Ummah, and sharing meaningful experiences and fun together.

communityRole.title: Our Role in the Community
roles: Acts as a bridge between youth and community institutions.
Supports mosque initiatives while filling youth engagement gaps.
Builds unity between Hungarian reverts and international Muslims.
Expands volunteerism culture among young Muslims.

achievements.title: Our Achievements
list: Organized Ramadan Sadaqa Programs supporting families in need.
Launched a Youth Internship Project to empower young Muslims.
Initiated the Gaza Student Support Campaign.
First to start Marriage Education & Matching Programs in Hungary.
Introduced the first Du'aa Training Program.
Hosted successful events in multiple mosques.
Operated fully through volunteer work without financial support.
First Muslim youth group to collaborate with Hungarian universities.
Helped build a successful, empowered Muslim generation.
